subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should authorized shared-agent users be allowed to receive provider usage, cost, and runtime details from `/status` and `session_status`, and if not, should suppression be global, per-agent, or field-based?
rationale: The repository does not currently define shared-agent status disclosure as a security boundary, and the choice determines the canonical config owner, default behavior, structured tool details, and upgrade contract.

options.title: Per-Agent Least Disclosure
options.body: Add a per-agent field allowlist or visibility policy, preserving the full owner-facing status card by default while suppressing selected details on configured shared agents.

options.title: Global Card Toggle
options.body: Add one global boolean that replaces or suppresses the complete rendered card across both chat and tool surfaces, accepting reduced flexibility.

options.title: Keep Trusted-Operator Contract
options.body: Reject a new visibility setting and document that status commands are intended only for authorized trusted operators, with channel allowlists as the supported control.

recommendation.title: Per-Agent Least Disclosure
recommendation.body: Add a per-agent field allowlist or visibility policy, preserving the full owner-facing status card by default while suppressing selected details on configured shared agents.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from both the central status-path commit provenance and the existing issue-level product review.
